name: Ken's Sourdough
tagline: Software engineer turned baker. I debug dough now.
bio: I spent ten years writing code, then fell for a jar of flour and water. Now I bake naturally leavened bread in small batches: long ferments, dark crusts, open crumb. Every loaf gets a git-style commit message on the bag.
